column5: An address acting as a master for the first time is what a rogue master looks like; so does a new engineering station
A device nobody has seen before on the control network; a replaced or added device looks the same
A known device answering a new protocol: a change worth knowing, with no technique of its own
A known master reaching a device it never used: a change worth knowing, with no technique of its own
One master reaching many devices it never talked to is how a search for devices looks
A first use of an operation that changes nothing on the device
A first use of an operation that changes something; whether it was authorised is for a person to say
A rate far above what was learned; what it means depends on the operation
A device or master that was always there has stopped; an attack is one cause, a fault or planned work are others
The sensor's own health, not the plant's
A note that one pass found more than it sends
The program's own limit, reached; a scan or forged addresses are the likely cause, and other detections name those
